entry.title: dotnet/efcore - Issues & Pull Requests - 2026-10-23
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • dotnet ef migrations script --idempotent can generate invalid PostgreSQL SQL #39396

Closed

  • GroupBy element projection evaluates a conversion around `g.Key` on the client instead of as a SQL `CAST` #39367
    12.0-preview1
  • NullReferenceException when an element value converter of a primitive collection returns null for a non-null element (read on 10.0 and 11.0, write on 10.0) #39245
    11.0.0
  • TPC: columns of a complex property inherited by a leaf table lose the complex property prefix, and adding a second one of the same type swaps the data #39244
    11.0.0
  • EF Core 11 regression: FromSql on an entity with a JSON complex property throws NullReferenceException in GenerateComplexJsonShaper #39251
    11.0.0
  • Hidden Exception in LazyLoader.Load(..) Due to exception in InternalEntry.SetIsLoaded(..) #34167
    12.0-preview1
  • context.ChangeTracker.Clear() shouldn't reset LocalViews #36543
    12.0-preview1

PullRequests

Created

  • [release/11.0]: Bump SQLite3MC.PCLRaw.bundle from 2.4.0 to 2.6.1 #39395
    area-infrastructure
  • [release/11.0]: Bump OpenTelemetry.Exporter.InMemory from 1.19.1 to 1.20.0 #39394
    area-infrastructure
  • [release/11.0]: Bump Microsoft.DotNet.XUnitV3Extensions from 11.0.0-beta.26514.118 to 11.0.0-beta.26523.3 #39393
    area-infrastructure
  • [release/11.0]: Bump FSharp.Core from 11.0.100 to 11.0.101 #39392
    area-infrastructure
  • [automated] Merge branch 'release/10.0' => 'release/11.0' #39391
  • Add query batching: execute multiple LINQ queries in a single round-trip #39390
    community-contribution

Merged

  • [release/10.0]: Bump OpenTelemetry.Exporter.InMemory from 1.19.1 to 1.20.0 #39372
    area-infrastructure
  • Keep conversions around a grouping key on the server #39368
    community-contribution
  • [automated] Merge branch 'release/11.0' => 'main' #39348
  • [release/10.0]: Bump SQLite3MC.PCLRaw.bundle from 2.4.0 to 2.6.1 #39373
    area-infrastructure
  • Bump ip-address to 10.7.4 #39379
    area-infrastructure
  • [release/10.0]: Bump SQLitePCLRaw.bundle_e_sqlite3 from 2.1.13 to 2.1.14 #39374
    area-infrastructure
  • Don't hide lazy loading failures behind the IsLoaded exception #39387
    community-contribution, 12.0-preview1
  • Keep local view bindings when the change tracker is cleared #39385
    community-contribution, 12.0-preview1

Updated

  • Fix unbound parameter reporting for prefix-less and positional parameters #39371
    community-contribution
  • [release/11.0] Use live version of System.Security.Cryptography.Pkcs #39350
    area-infrastructure
